per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The sign-up process for the pay-as-you-go option should take under 5 minutes to complete.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: System shall let customers register on the website as a "pay as you go" user in under 5 minutes.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The sign-up process for the subscription option should take under 10 minutes to complete.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: System shall let customers register on the website as a "unlimited movie subscriber" user in under 10 minutes.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The sign-up process should not exceed four pages.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Users should only have to navigate through a maximum of 4 pages to create an account with the website.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: After logging in, users should be able to start streaming a movie within two clicks.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Users should be able to access their streaming movies in under 2 clicks after logging into the website.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Any action that involves clicking, such as logging in or opening a page, should take no more than five seconds to respond.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Any interface between a user and the automated system shall have a maximum response time of 5 seconds unless noted by an exception below.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The login process should take no more than five seconds to complete.
The process from choosing a movie to hitting play should take no more than three minutes.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy for customers with novice skills on the Internet to purchase and watch streaming movies. Customers should be able to purchase and watch a pre-determined movie in under 3 minutes.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The streaming should start within ten seconds of buffering; otherwise, it is perceived as broken.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: When streaming a movie the buffering time should take no longer than 10 seconds (plus any latency on the user's connection.)'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The site should adapt to slow connections by offering lower-quality streaming options or clearer messages.
The site should be usable by 9 out of 10 non-technical users (e.g., an aunt who only uses WhatsApp) without assistance.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product should be able to be used by 90% of novice users on the Internet.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The site should have an uptime of 99.5%.
During downtime, the site should display clear messages with estimated recovery times and refund options.
The site should not have cluttered pages with too many ads or auto-playing content.
The site should offer alternative password methods, such as magic links, to accommodate users who are not familiar with complex password requirements.
